name: Winyé
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

sources.citation: OLAC page for kst (Internet Archive copy 2026-01-24) and WALS Online 'Ko (Winye)' (kow)
sources.note: OLAC lists only Glottolog/WALS/Ethnologue entries (no archived descriptions); WALS has 3 features for kow, none prosodic.

sources.citation: Kouraogo, Yacouba. 2024. Polysémie et homonymie en wɩnɩɛ. Akofena 14(5): 459-470.
sources.note: Lexicology; p. 460 'Dans une langue à tons comme le wɩnɩ́ɛ' (homonyms must be 'homotones'); nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Kouraogo, Yacouba & Asséta Diallo. 2023. Structures des syntagmes nominaux de détermination en wɩnɩɛ. Ziglôbitha 8: 71-88.
sources.note: Syntax article; 'absence de compacité tonale' used as a phrase-vs-compound criterion; nothing on stress. Its bibliography (pp. 86-88) is the fullest inventory of wɩnɩɛ descriptions (Prost 1972; Sawadogo 1994, 2001; Zerbo 1994; Kouraogo 2015, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021).

sources.citation: Kouraogo, Yacouba. 2021. Prédication verbale complexe en wɩnɩɛ. Langues & Usages (Université de Béjaia) 5: 47-60.
sources.note: Syntax article. Methodological note p. 49: all tones (high, mid, low) transcribed, 'le schème tonal ne joue aucun rôle particulier dans la formation des phrases'. Nothing on stress/accent. Data from Oury (Boucle du Mouhoun).

sources.citation: Kouraogo, Yacouba. 2020. Structure canonique de la phrase verbale simple en wɪnɪɛ. Akofena 2(2): 537-550.
sources.note: Syntax article with verbal morphophonology (vowel lowering/elision of the affirmative -U); tones marked in examples; nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Kẽdrebéogo, Gérard & Zakaria Yago. 1986. Langues du Burkina Faso: les langues gurunsi. Ouagadougou: CNRST/IRSSH & ACCT.
sources.note: Comparative wordlists (Winyé appears as 'Wunyema') in phonetic transcription with tone marks; no phonological description; silent on stress. Bibliography lists Prost 1972 (33 p., 1 map) and Girault s.d. 'Vocabulaires comparatifs (Winye, phwo, nuni, sisale)', ms.

sources.citation: Prost, André. 1972. Enquête sommaire sur le Ko, langue gourounsi de la Haute-Volta. Publications du Département de Linguistique Générale et des Langues Négro-Africaines 18. Dakar: Université de Dakar. 33 pp. + map.
